1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 1 m de longitud, con aletas radiadas, cuerpo alargado y comprimido lateralmente, de color plateado, y una gran boca de dientes afilados donde sobresale la mandíbula inferior; es comestible. GempylidaeGempylus serpens.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish, up to 1 m in length, with radiated fins, elongated and laterally compressed body, silvery color, and a large mouth with sharp teeth where the lower jaw protrudes; it is edible. Gempylidae Gempylus serpens.
